landing.title: Tools for Chinese teachers, built on ChineseReads
landing.subtitle: Organise your students, generate study plans, worksheets and dictations, and give every student access to ChineseReads.
landing.ctaLogin: Log in with your ChineseReads account
landing.feature1Text: Create a group, share an invite code and see who joined. Each student gets premium access to ChineseReads while their seat is active.
landing.feature2Text: Study plans per student or group, worksheets, character sheets and dictations generated for your level and topic.
landing.feature3Text: Exercises on vocabulary, grammar and pronunciation that your students complete online, with results you can review.

forTeachers.title: What a teacher gets
forTeachers.intro: Academy is for private Chinese teachers and small academies. One annual subscription, up to ten students included.
forTeachers.point1: A teacher area to create groups and invite students with a code.
forTeachers.point2: Each active student gets ChineseReads premium: unlimited texts, audio and the AI word tutor.
forTeachers.point3: Materials generated for each group: study plans, worksheets, dictations and exercises.
forTeachers.point4: Everything is reusable: generate once for the group, every student benefits.
forTeachers.status: Academy is being built. Leave us your email on ChineseReads and we will tell you when it opens.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: A single plan for teachers. Students never pay.
pricing.includes1: Up to 10 students with ChineseReads premium
pricing.hypothesis: Launch price, subject to change before the public opening.
